clauses.text: The policy shall require that every digital payment product/service offered addresses the mechanics, clear definition of starting point, critical intermittent stages/points and end point in the digital payment cycle, security aspects, validations till the digital payment is settled, clear pictorial representation of digital path, exception handling, signing off of the above requirements, mechanism for carrying out User Acceptance Tests (UAT) in multiple stages before roll-out, sign off from multiple stakeholders [post UAT], and data archival requirements.

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: A. Governance and Management of Security Risks

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: A. Governance and Management of Security Risks

clauses.text: The bank shall conduct risk assessments with regard to the safety and security of digital payment products/services and associated processes as well as suitability and appropriateness of the same vis-à-vis the target users, both prior to establishing the service(s) and regularly thereafter.

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: A. Governance and Management of Security Risks

clauses.text: The bank shall develop sound internal control systems and take into account the operational risk before offering digital payment products and related services.

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: A. Governance and Management of Security Risks

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure that its digital payment architecture is robust and scalable, commensurate with the transaction volumes and customer growth.

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: A. Governance and Management of Security Risks

clauses.text: The bank shall have necessary capacity, systems, and procedures in place to periodically test backed-up data and applications pertaining to digital products/services to ensure recovery without loss of transactions or audit-trails.

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: A. Governance and Management of Security Risks

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: B. Other Generic Security Controls

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: B. Other Generic Security Controls

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: B. Other Generic Security Controls

clauses.text: The bank shall adopt internationally accepted and published standards that are not deprecated/demonstrated to be insecure/vulnerable and shall ensure that the configurations involved in implementing such controls are compliant with extant laws and regulatory instructions.

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: B. Other Generic Security Controls

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: B. Other Generic Security Controls

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: B. Other Generic Security Controls

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: C. Application Security Life Cycle

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: C. Application Security Life Cycle

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: C. Application Security Life Cycle

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: C. Application Security Life Cycle

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter III - General Controls :: G. Customer Protection, Awareness and Grievance Redressal Mechanism

clauses.text: A virtual keyboard option shall be made available.

clauses.chapter_title: Chapter IV - Internet Banking Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: An online session shall be automatically terminated after a fixed period of inactivity.
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation, but has no hard penalty or deadline attached.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter IV - Internet Banking Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure secure delivery of password for login purpose. The password generated and dispatched by the bank shall be valid for a limited period from the date of its creation. If the password is generated and dispatched by the bank, then the user shall be compulsorily required to change the password, on the first login.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard deadline, monetary penalty, mandatory disclosure obligation, or explicit compliance requirement.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter IV - Internet Banking Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: When the internet banking application is accessed through external websites (e.g., in case of payment of taxes, e-commerce transactions), the procedure for authentication and the appearance/look/feel of the bank's internet banking site shall be made uniform as far as possible.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard deadline, monetary penalty, mandatory disclosure obligation, or explicit compliance requirement.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter IV - Internet Banking Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: On detection of any anomalies or exceptions for which the mobile application was not programmed, the customer shall be directed to remove the current copy / instance of the application and proceed with installation of a new copy / instance of the application.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard deadline
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure implementation of the following specific controls for mobile applications:
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (i) device policy enforcement [allowing the installation / execution of applications only after baseline requirements defined based on the bank's risk assessment, are met. The baseline requirements shall include but not be limited to checks for vulnerable operating system, vulnerable or malicious applications, and insecure Wi-Fi configurations];
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (ii) application secure download / install;
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (iii) deactivating older application versions in a phased but time-bound manner (not exceeding six months from the date of release of newer version) i.e., maintaining only one version (excluding the overlap period while phasing out older version) of the mobile application on a platform / operating system;
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard deadline
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (iv) ability to identify remote access applications (to the extent possible) and prohibit login access to the mobile application;
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (v) storage of customer data;
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (vi) device or application encryption (to prevent compromise of sensitive customer information stored on the device);
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (vii) ensuring minimal data collection / app permissions;
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (viii) application sandbox / containerisation;
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (ix) code obfuscation.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank may perform validation on the security and compatibility condition of the device / operating system and the mobile application to ensure that activities relating to the account are put through the mobile application in a safe and secure manner.
clauses.reason: clause is definitional
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank may explore the feasibility of implementing a code that checks if the device is rooted / jailbroken prior to the installation of the mobile application and disallow the mobile application to install / function if the phone is rooted / jailbroken.
clauses.reason: clause is definitional
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall host the checksum of current active version of its mobile application on public platform so that users can verify the same. A checksum may be treated as a unique mechanism for identifying the bank's mobile application and for distinguishing it from unauthorised or rogue mobile applications.
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure device binding of the mobile application. Device binding shall be implemented through a combination of hardware, software, and service information.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: In case, the bank allows multiple devices to be registered, then (i) the user shall be notified of every new device registration on multiple channels such as registered mobile number, email, or phone call, and (ii) in relation to the mobile application, the bank shall maintain a record of all registered devices, providing the user a facility to disable a registered device.
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank may implement alternatives to SMS-based OTP authentication mechanisms.
clauses.reason: clause is definitional
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The mobile application shall require re-authentication whenever the device or application remains unused for a designated period and each time the user launches the application.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard deadline
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure that mobile applications are able to identify new network connections or connections from unsecured networks, such as unsecured Wi-Fi connections, and shall implement appropriate authentication / checks / measures to perform transactions under such circumstances.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The mobile application shall not store / retain sensitive personal / customer authentication information such as user IDs, passwords, keys, hashes, and hard coded references, on the device and the application shall securely wipe all sensitive customer information from memory when the customer / user exits the application.
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure that its mobile application limits writing of sensitive information into 'temp' files. The sensitive information written in such files shall be suitably encrypted / masked / hashed and stored securely.
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank may consider designing anti-malware capabilities into its mobile application.
clauses.reason: clause is definitional
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure to (i) avoid usage of raw (visible) Structured Query Language (SQL) queries in mobile applications to fetch or update data from databases;
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (ii) secure mobile applications from SQL injection type of vulnerabilities;
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (iii) write sensitive information to the database in an encrypted form (database here refers to the database in the mobile application at client's end. The bank shall encrypt the sensitive data stored in the database used by the mobile application.);
clauses.reason: clause imposes a hard requirement
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (iv) prevent loading web content, as part of the mobile application's layout if errors are detected during Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) / Transport Layer Security (TLS) negotiation;
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: (v) display certificate errors on account of the certificate not being signed by a recognised certificate authority or due to expiry / revocation of the certificate, to the user.
clauses.reason: clause describes a process or procedure with a customer-facing obligation
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter V - Mobile Payments Application Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall follow various payment card standards [over and above Payment Card Industry-Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) and Payment Card Industry-Software Security Framework (PCI-SSF)] as per Payment Card Industry (PCI) prescriptions for comprehensive payment card security as per applicability / readiness of updated versions of the standards such as:
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: With reference to paragraph 69(1), though formal certification may not be mandatory, the bank shall follow these standards holistically, as per applicability.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall put up a status report on compliance with these standards to its IT Strategy Committee, as prescribed under Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions, 2026, for deliberation and appropriate action.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure that terminals installed at the merchants for capturing card details for payments or otherwise are validated against the PCI-P2PE program to use PCI-approved P2PE solutions and
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: PoS terminals with PIN entry installed at the merchants for capturing card payments (including the double swipe terminals) are approved by the PCI-PTS program. While deploying any new PoS terminals, the bank shall ensure that such terminals are certified in accordance with PCI-PTS requirements.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank as an Acquirer shall secure its card payment infrastructure [Unique Key Per Terminal (UKPT) or Derived Unique Key Per Transaction (DUKPT) / Terminal Line Encryption (TLE)].
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall implement the following controls at the HSMs: The HSMs shall have logging enabled and the logs must themselves be tamper proof.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall mitigate the risk of single point of failure at HSM by implementing 'clustering' for high availability and ensuring secure backups.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure access to the HSM through Access Control Lists (ACLs).
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall maintain separate ACLs for each individual application to ensure application-level isolation.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall manage and monitor access to HSM using a robust Privileged Identity and Access Management solution.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure decryption and validation of keys, PIN at HSM.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure card PIN generation and printing directly at system connected to HSM.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure generation and validation of CVV at HSM.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure that HSM is implemented with secure PIN block format with controls to disable outputting PIN block in weaker format.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure secure key management for HSMs, including Local Master Keys (LMKs).
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure proper security for the maintenance of physical keys of the HSM.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure the following for improving the security posture of the ATM: implement security measures such as Basic Input / Output System (BIOS) password, disabling Universal Serial Bus (USB) ports, disabling auto-run facility, applying the latest patches of operating system, and other software, terminal security solution, time-based admin access;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall implement anti-skimming and whitelisting solution; and
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall upgrade all ATMs with supported versions of operating system.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: With regard to card transactions, the bank shall: ensure robust surveillance / monitoring of card transactions (especially overseas cash withdrawals) and setting up of rules and limits commensurate with its risk appetite;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall take up with the card network and/or ATM network, to put in place transaction limits at card, Bank Identification Number (BIN) as well as at the bank level. Such limits shall be mandatorily set at the card network switch itself. Limits may be mandated for domestic as well as international transactions separately;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall put in place transaction control mechanisms with necessary caps (restrictions on transactions), if any of the limits set as per the above requirement is breached. A periodic review mechanism of such limits set as per the risk appetite of the bank shall be put in place as per the Board-approved policy;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall institute a mechanism to monitor breaches, if any, on a 24x7 basis, including weekends, and holidays and put in place a robust incident response mechanism to mitigate the fraud loss, on account of suspicious transactions, if any;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure that card details of the customers are not stored in plain text at the bank and its vendor(s) locations, systems, and applications;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank shall ensure that the processing of card details in readable format is performed in a secure manner to strictly avoid data leakage of sensitive customer information.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The bank using card data scanning tools to identify unencrypted (clear text) payments card data in its ecosystem especially during audits, shall adhere to the following safety measures: any tool (procured by / from a third-party) for the purpose of scanning of unencrypted card data shall first be tested in a test environment to understand the scope and impact of the tool's capabilities;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: The scanning tool shall be installed only in the bank's premises on its devices;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: Card data scanning shall not be done remotely;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: Discovered data, if any, shall reside in the scanning tool;
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: Exportable card data shall be appropriately masked (no data, even masked, shall be taken out of the bank's premises / infrastructure);
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)

clauses.text: Service providers shall be provided limited access to conduct the scan or analyse the data, and such access shall be provided only on the bank's devices.
clauses.chapter_title: Chapter VI - Card Payment Security Controls :: (full chapter)
